# Stock Analysis

> > A comprehensive free platform for analyzing 130k+ global stocks with real-time data, screening tools, and financial metrics.

Stock Analysis provides investors with free access to stock prices, financial data, charts, and analysis tools across major exchanges including NYSE, Nasdaq, and international markets. The platform combines market data, screening capabilities, and equity research tools to help users make informed investment decisions.

## Key Topics

- Stock Screener
- Market Data
- Watchlist & Portfolio Tracking
- Stock Ticker Symbols
- ETF Analysis
- IPO Tracker
- Analyst Ratings
- S&P 500
- Nasdaq 100
- Stock Comparison
- Sector Analysis
- Corporate Actions
- Stock Recommendations
- Investment Tools
- Equity Research

## Core Analysis Tools

- [Stock Analysis - Free Online Stock Information for Investors](https://stockanalysis.com): Homepage with stock prices, financial data, charts for 130k+ global stocks
- [Free Stock Screener - Search, Filter and Analyze Stocks](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/screener): Stock screener with 297 indicators, filters, analysis tools updated per minute
- [Stock Watchlist & Portfolio Tracker](https://stockanalysis.com/watchlist): Free watchlist and portfolio tracker for stocks and ETFs with real-time data
- [Stock Comparison Tool](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/compare): Compare stocks like AAPL, NVDA, MSFT on performance and financial metrics
- [Free ETF Screener - Search and Analyze ETFs](https://stockanalysis.com/etf/screener): ETF screener with 106 indicators from Vanguard, iShares, State Street, Invesco

## Stock Data & Reference

- [List of All Stock Ticker Symbols](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks): Comprehensive stock ticker symbol directory with price, financial, stats data
- [Stock Lists - Stock Analysis](https://stockanalysis.com/list): Curated stock lists ranked by market cap, dividends, employees, sales
- [Stock Sectors & Industries](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/industry): 11 sectors and 145 industries for stock categorization and sector analysis
- [List of Stock Exchanges](https://stockanalysis.com/list/exchanges): Global stock exchange directory including NYSE, LSE, TSE, BSE, Frankfurt
- [Corporate Actions List - Recent and Historical](https://stockanalysis.com/actions): Recent and historical US stock corporate actions, splits, acquisitions, delistings

## IPO Information & Tools

- [IPO Screener: Search and Filter Upcoming IPOs](https://stockanalysis.com/ipos/screener): IPO screening tool to search, filter, compare all upcoming US IPOs
- [200 Most Recent IPOs](https://stockanalysis.com/ipos): Last 200 IPOs with prices, dates, returns, and detailed IPO information
- [IPO Calendar - Upcoming IPOs](https://stockanalysis.com/ipos/calendar): Upcoming IPO calendar with dates, prices, and share offer information
- [IPO Statistics and Charts](https://stockanalysis.com/ipos/statistics): IPO statistics and charts with annual data 2000-2026, monthly 2019-2026
- [Latest IPO News](https://stockanalysis.com/ipos/news): Latest news on recent and upcoming IPOs on the US stock market

## Analyst Research & Insights

- [Top Wall Street Stock Analysts](https://stockanalysis.com/analysts): Wall Street analysts ranked by success rate and average return per rating
- [Top 50 Strong Buy Stocks](https://stockanalysis.com/analysts/top-stocks): Top 50 Strong Buy stocks from best performing Wall Street analysts
